whoItsFor: Developers and teams who want to connect company tools like databases, Stripe, WorkOS, PostHog, files and APIs into one queryable ontology, running locally with no accounts and no hosting.
useCases: Unify customer and account records across Stripe, WorkOS, and the production database
Ask natural-language questions of company data with SQL-backed, cited answers
Explore support tickets, subscriptions, invoices and SSO connections as one connected graph

requirements.runtime: Docker with Compose v2 plugin, git, bash, openssl
